description: List the authenticated user's ticket orders (attendee side), with the event expanded. time_filter narrows to upcoming or past events. view:"brief" answers one line per order — event name — start (local ISO) or "no date" — order status — inside the untrusted-data envelope, upcoming orders only unless time_filter says otherwise; a partial page ends with a "-- next: continuation=<token>" note to pass back as continuation.

continuation.description: Pagination continuation token from a previous response

time_filter.description: Filter orders by event time (default all; current_future under view:"brief")

view.description: compact (default) strips image/avatar URLs; "full" returns Eventbrite's payload untouched; "brief" returns one line per order: event name — start or "no date" — status (upcoming by default).

name: eb_my_orders
